title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker7-edhoc: edhoc.json interop vectors use placeholder values
description:
## Summary

`test/vectors/edhoc.json` contains placeholder values (`4242...` repeating) for entries like `prk_2e` and `th_2` instead of actual computed test vectors. This means the cross-implementation test vectors stored in the repo do not match the current code (even post-fix).

## Location

`test/vectors/edhoc.json` lines 13-14:
```json
"prk_2e": "42424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242",
"th_2": "42424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242424242",
```

## Impact

Any implementation consuming these test vectors gets wrong expectations. The in-code Rust test vectors (in `rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors`) are correctly updated by the current commit, but the JSON interop file is out of sync.

## Fix

After all TH/transcript fixes are complete, regenerate the full test vectors from the Python reference oracle and update all placeholder entries to actual computed values.
